propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket schemas omit write parameters (force, caused_by, ref, reason) already supported by the library and CLI, making them unreachable over MCP
FastMCP derives input model and JSON schema from handwritten callable signatures in _mcp_writes.py; undeclared payload keys are discarded before the registered callable executes
The MCP adapter bodies independently forward only close_class or assignee, so adding fields to signatures alone would not pass them through without also updating the adapter delegate calls
MCP ref selection and caused_by edge creation were confirmed to stop at the adapter boundary instead of reaching the shared library core
The signed 2026-08-18 operator ruling rescinds the old CLI/library-only force policy and establishes parity across all surfaces with absent certification as the audit signal
